title: hive-rule resolve: response body
description: The effective rules with their rendered lines, the conflicts found, what was excluded and why, and the resolved-rule digest, present only when there is no conflict. A caller whose action depends on a conflicted subject holds that action.

rules.description: In the order they apply: by scope from widest to narrowest, then by effective time.

excluded.description: Rules in scope that were not applied, each with the reason.

reason.description: expired-by-clock: past its expiry time, receipt or not. not-yet-effective: before its effective time. lifted, ended. superseded: a rule in force for this scope, role and instant names it in changes with the relation supersedes. overridden: a narrower scope governs the subject. role: the rule does not apply to the role asked.

digest.description: The resolved-rule digest: the digest of the canonical form of the rules array. Absent when conflicts is not empty.
